verdict.rationale: Authy's documented programmatic surface is the developer-facing Authy API and SDK, which websites use to add 2FA to their own apps. That API is now closed to new customers. Nothing in the evidence documents an API, CLI, or other surface that lets an agent create or update entries in a user's Authy vault: new TOTP secrets are added by capturing QR codes in the app, and community reports describe even reading secrets back out as requiring hacks. The developer SDK and Twilio Verify's TOTP are adjacent building blocks for a different role, not vault-entry management, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
